# x-use

> x-use is an open-source Python MCP server and CLI for X (Twitter). It uses the operator's authenticated browser session for profile and post research, inbox reads, and reviewed publishing and outreach. It runs locally with Patchright Chromium and does not require official X API credentials.

Version 3.2.0 has 82 tools, seven prompts, four read-only resource patterns and seven bundled agent skills, built on the MCP Python SDK v2 line. 3.1.0 added runtime diagnostics, campaign previews, bookmarks, reviewed post edit/delete and inbox controls to the 70 tools in 3.0.0. The package-name x-use-mcp command starts MCP directly for registry clients. This file is an optional documentation map for agents, not a search-ranking mechanism.

The package name is `x-use-mcp`; the MCP Registry name is `io.github.ihuzaifashoukat/x-use`. The license is MIT. Install or upgrade with `python -m pip install --upgrade x-use-mcp`, then install the matching browser with `python -m patchright install chromium`.

## Capabilities and limits

- Public profile, post/reply/media and bounded thread reads; structured notifications; visible inbox and conversation reads; local leads and campaigns; reviewed messages, follows, and multi-post threads.
- Inbox folders are inbox, requests and other. All/unread/read filters preserve unknown read state. Visible results are partial; opening conversations or notifications may change native read state.
- Account analytics currently detects the supported Premium gate. It does not return unavailable metrics or infer account analytics from local action counters.
- Ordinary publishing tools stage drafts by default. Messages, follows and thread starts require draft approval. Direct mode, explicit queue execution, opt-in auto-drain and legacy batch cycles have their own execution paths; do not assume every write always waits for a new approval.
- Durable local budgets, account locks, exact-target checks and uncertain-outcome journals reduce duplicate actions. They do not guarantee anonymity, permanent sessions or protection from account restrictions.
- Each active account has an isolated in-memory browser context and configured proxy route. The shared Chromium process is bounded; an unlocked encrypted inbox lasts only while its context remains available. Restart recovery may need fresh cookies or owner-provided PIN entry.
- Interactive text comes from the calling AI client. Server-side generation requires an optional OpenAI-compatible LLM configuration. The project does not require an official X API key.
- Python 3.11–3.14 is covered by the CI matrix on Windows, Linux and macOS. Synthetic browser tests and controlled live checks are documented separately; no test count proves universal live compatibility.

## Setup and workflow documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/README.md): choose a guide by task.
- [Practical workflows](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/WORKFLOWS.md): research, reply drafts, inbox, individual outreach, campaign preview and threads, with fictional examples.
- [README](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/README.md): install, configure clients and discover workflows.
- [Setup prompt](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/SETUP_PROMPT.md): installation and client registration.
- [MCP guide](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/MCP_GUIDE.md): tool groups, prompts, resources and result semantics.
- [Browser runtime](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/BROWSER_RUNTIME.md): account contexts, inbox folders, outreach, threads and recovery.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/CONFIG_REFERENCE.md): settings, account overrides, MCP policy and queue behavior.
- [Presets](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/presets/README.md): current MCP starters, legacy batch templates and personas.
- [Data directory](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/data/README.md): tracked examples versus private runtime state.
- [Plugin](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/plugins/x-use/README.md): Claude Code plugin and bundled skills.

## Development and evidence

- [October 12 audit](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/AUDIT_2026-10-12.md): current installation, complete protocol coverage, browser checks, bug fixes and explicit live-testing limits.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): runtime, policy, storage and compatibility paths.
- [Resilience audit](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/RESILIENCE_AUDIT.md): findings, fixes, evidence and limitations.
- [Tool validation](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/docs/TOOL_VALIDATION.md): coverage and live status for each registered tool.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): isolated tests, code changes and release preparation.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history and migration notes.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/ihuzaifashoukat/x-use/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): remaining work.
- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/x-use-mcp/): published distributions.

Documentation links above follow main. For a specific release, use the matching Git tag and its CI results.
